_doc: How big a file is, in the words both apps show (src/gui/pages/media/api.rs size_words, web/pages/media-app.js sizeWords): bytes, then KB rounded, then MB with one decimal below 100 and whole above, then GB with one decimal; a decimal that is exactly half way rounds UP (1.25 MB reads 1.3 MB), the way the browser's toFixed does. Each case is [bytes, words].
